description: This file contains implementation of block layout classes and methods for shader variable layout calculations, including classes for different layout encodings and traversal utilities for shader variables.

classes.name: BlockLayoutMapVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for encoding shader variables into block layout map.

classes.name: BaseAlignmentVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for calculating base alignment of shader variables.

classes.name: BlockLayoutEncoder
classes.description: Base class for encoding block layout information.

classes.name: DummyBlockEncoder
classes.description: Dummy implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder, provides no layout info.

classes.name: Std140BlockEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder for std140 layout rules.

classes.name: Std430BlockEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder for std430 layout rules.

classes.name: VariableNameVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for managing variable naming and path collapsing.

classes.name: BlockEncoderVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for encoding shader variables into block layout.

methods.name: encodeVariable
methods.description: Encodes a shader variable into block layout, overriding in subclasses.

methods.name: GetInterfaceBlockInfo
methods.description: Collects block layout info for interface blocks.

methods.name: TraverseStructVariable
methods.description: Traverses a struct shader variable for layout calculation.

methods.name: TraverseStructArrayVariable
methods.description: Traverses an array of struct shader variables.

methods.name: CollapseNameStack
methods.description: Concatenates name parts into a full variable name.

methods.name: GetStd430BaseAlignment
methods.description: Calculates base alignment for std430 layout.

methods.name: BaseAlignmentVisitor::visitVariable
methods.description: Calculates maximum base alignment among variables.

methods.name: BlockLayoutEncoder::encodeType
methods.description: Encodes a variable type into block layout info.

methods.name: BlockLayoutEncoder::getShaderVariableSize
methods.description: Calculates size of a shader variable.

methods.name: Std140BlockEncoder::getBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Calculates layout info for std140 layout.

methods.name: Std430BlockEncoder::getBaseAlignment
methods.description: Calculates base alignment for std430 layout.
